    Transfer of the axioms from the realization (Corollary 2.4) #

    On C_J, a sequence realizes δ exactly when its image under the realization functor, with third morphism η δ, is distinguished: realizations go to distinguished triangles, and conversely a distinguished triangle is compared with the image of a realization of δ (which exists in C(D) and lies in C_J), and the comparison isomorphism lifts along the fully faithful realization functor. The axioms of an extriangulated category then follow from those of the triangulated category K(Q) [NP, Remark 2.18].

    ∃ (E : (labelsIn D J).FullSubcategory) (d : X ⟶ E) (e : E ⟶ Y) (φ : (R.realP hR).obj E ≅ Z), dataJ.Realizes ε d e ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((R.realP hR).map d) φ.hom = a ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φ.hom b = (R.realP hR).map e

    A distinguished triangle F X → Z → F Y → (F X)⟦1⟧ with third morphism η ε comes from a realization of ε.

    ∃ (E : (labelsIn D J).FullSubcategory) (h'' : C' ⟶ E) (d : D' ⟶ E) (e : E ⟶ F') (δ'' : dataJ.Ext E A), dataJ.Realizes δ'' (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) h'' ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f' d = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g h'' ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h'' e = g' ∧ dataJ.Realizes ((dataJ.push f') δ') d e ∧ (dataJ.pull d) δ'' = δ ∧ (dataJ.push f) δ'' = (dataJ.pull e) δ'
